⚽ OGO ERA

The game that onboards the world into Fluid. A street-football RPG — Lagos culture, real ownership.

How it works

1. Play. Fast street-football matches — phone-first, Lagos pitch energy, players everywhere.

2. Grow your Companion. Your soulbound Companion NFT levels up with your match stats. It can never be sold or taken — it is you in the game.

3. Earn RAIN. Match rewards and tournament drops accrue as RAIN. Claim with one tap — it lands in this Fluid wallet, on-chain, yours.

4. Spend it anywhere. RAIN sits beside your BTC, ETH and stablecoins — send it, or cash out to a bank in 180+ countries.

Status: wallet-first

The claim plumbing is being built BEFORE the game launches: RAIN drops use signed Merkle proofs (you claim directly; Fluid never custodies rewards), and the Companion contract already lives in the open-source repo, ready for Sui testnet.
